Name: Unique Fish Additions - SVE - Compatibility Fix
Author: viccallan
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Fixed naming compatibility with the Tadpole causing errors and menu flickering when checking the Stardew Aquarium donation list. NOTE: You only need this mod if you have both Unique Fish Additions and Stardew Valley Expanded. 

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Use Mod manager or[/*]
[*]unzip and drop the unzipped folder into  the Stardew Valley\Mods folder, say yes when it asks if you want to replace the files.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Fixed a compatibility issue.

Mod will be removed  if either mods are updated.  [/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Unique Fish Additions and Stardew Valley Expanded [/color]
